expectedIssues: An icon is missing from the top right corner, only a red dot is visible
reportedIssues: The circular button in the top-right of the header is empty (light gray circle) apart from a small red notification dot — the expected icon (profile avatar or notification bell) appears to be missing or failed to load.

In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card is cut hard by the viewport edge and its title reads 'Trattoria Piccol' with the word sliced mid-character and no ellipsis, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
The category chip row is also clipped at the right edge with a barely visible sliver of the next chip, giving no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: white circle with dark outline heart on the ramen card, dark/translucent circle with white heart on the pizza card.

Thumbnail treatments in the 'Fastest near you' row are inconsistent — the Green Bowl Poké tile has a pale gray background while the other two are dark, so the white 'min' badge contrast varies and the row looks unbalanced.
The second 'Popular right now' card is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no bottom padding, hiding its title/rating and making the list feel truncated.
Icon-only controls (header button, heart/favorite buttons, search icon) have no visible text labels; if they also lack accessible names they are unusable with screen readers.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes the top-right circular control appearing empty except for a small red notification dot, matching the missing icon defect.
